title: DECEPTIVE AI SYSTEMS THAT GIVE EXPLANATIONS ARE JUST AS CONVINCING AS HONEST AI SYSTEMS IN HUMAN-MACHINE DECISION MAKING
reasoning: The paper describes a behavioral experiment investigating how human discernment of news veracity is affected by honest or deceptive AI-generated explanations. While the study involves honesty and deception (moral concepts), it is primarily a study of misinformation and human trust rather than a formal evaluation or benchmark of religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
